title: Credit Administration Standards — Application, Credit Decision and Booking of Operating Lines of Credit
content:
An application for any of the Operating Lines of Credit is registered by the servicing desk and decided by a credit officer; an approved line is booked only once its closing conditions are met.

## Standards

1. **Registration and decision.** An application is registered with the product's official name, the commitment requested and the crop year, and is decided by a credit officer against the product's entry gate. The servicing desk registers applications but never approves or declines them.
2. **Decline.** A declined application is closed with the decision date; no line is booked.
3. **Closing conditions.** An approved line is booked only after the member has signed the note and security agreement, the financing statement has been filed and the member holds the stock or participation certificate required under the equity stock requirement of Member Equities & Patronage.
4. **Crop insurance.** For products whose crop insurance requirement applies, the line is booked only when the member holds a crop insurance policy in active status for the financed crop year whose indemnity is assigned to the association and whose coverage level is at least the product's minimum coverage level.
5. **Term dates.** On booking, the maturity date is the booking date plus the product's term in calendar months, and the advance cutoff date is the booking date plus the product's advance period in calendar months, never later than the maturity date. When the day does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used.

## Evidence for the crop insurance condition

The condition is met only by the association's own Crop Insurance records: a policy of the applying member, for the crop year the line finances, in active status, with the indemnity assigned to the association and a coverage level at or above the product's minimum. A member's statement that a policy exists, or a policy for another crop year, does not meet it. The condition is checked before the line is booked.

| Policy on record for the member | Booked on a product requiring crop insurance |
|---|---|
| Active, financed crop year, indemnity assigned, coverage at the minimum | Yes |
| Active, financed crop year, indemnity assigned, coverage above the minimum | Yes |
| Active, financed crop year, indemnity not assigned | No |
| Active, financed crop year, indemnity assigned, coverage below the minimum | No |
| Active, but for a different crop year | No |

## Term date examples (hypothetical booking dates)

- A Revolving Operating Line booked on 31 January matures on 31 January of the following year, and its advance cutoff date is the same day.
- A Seasonal Operating Loan booked on 31 May matures 14 calendar months later, on 31 July of the following year. Its advance cutoff date, 9 calendar months after booking, falls in February, which has no 31st day, so the cutoff is the last day of that February.
